name: inteiro
description: INTEIRO — Identity Design System pessoal, completo e production-ready

scripts.build: npm run build -w @inteiro/tokens && npm run build -w @inteiro/agent-core && npm run build -w @inteiro/cli && npm run build -w @inteiro/mcp && npm run build -w @inteiro/design-system && npm run build -w @inteiro/react && npm run build -w @inteiro/skills
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run -w @inteiro/tokens && npm pack --dry-run -w @inteiro/cli && npm pack --dry-run -w @inteiro/design-system
scripts.generate: npm run build -w @inteiro/tokens && npm run generate -w @inteiro/skills
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run validate && npm run test && npm run test:contrast && npm run build && npm run pack:check
